body:
# Overnight art batch: 4 October 2026

Owner: Codex art, thread `01a10869-af91-7490-9f19-c99e0842fcc1`, mailbox actor codex with ART subject prefix. Task `ART-OVERNIGHT-20261004`. State IN_PROGRESS.

Exact initial exclusive writes: this report; `assets/expeditions/production/9fo/v2/overnight-art-20261004/` (runtime copies, isolated QA and local manifest); `scripts/dev/qa-orchard-art-overnight-20261004.cjs`. Existing assets, source manifests, engine, generation, UI and shared outputs remain read-only. Renderer/global art claim depends on explicit legacy release, never inferred from time or shared actor.

Read master brief, AGENTS, implementation/generation specifications, delivery board, overnight handoff, art request/station handoff, pipeline, visual acceptance and owner reports. Dirty checkout preserved. Legacy TURNING-RAVINE and final-build remain active at initial claim.

Initial pixel evidence inspected: actual Turning Ravine tablet native and phone maximum browser screenshots dated 4 October, plus existing station identities-green contact. Ravine shows generic control/calibration/joint/stabiliser glyphs. Approved station silhouettes are distinct and available. Existing prepared Crosswind states exist; no genuinely missing bitmap is established, so no image generation is justified. Reuse, exact-hash QA and isolated compositions proceed while legacy claim is active.

Next: record selected hashes/bytes/alpha/bounds/anchors and inspect four backgrounds, small/native/zoom compositions. These compositions are asset evidence, not live App/device/child acceptance. Publish actionable resolver gaps and stable art inputs through local mailbox before/after batch. No shared full build.

## Stable independent batch delivered

17 exact-byte copies: seven painted station/socket identities, six existing code-native badges and four Crosswind states. Total 408,700 bytes. Local manifest: `assets/expeditions/production/9fo/v2/overnight-art-20261004/manifest.json`. Each record retains source path/hash, original runtime path, bytes/SHA-256, alpha diagnostics, bounds, ground anchor, safe areas and QA paths. Originals and global registries unchanged. No new image generation or image editing.

Reproduction: `node scripts/dev/qa-orchard-art-overnight-20261004.cjs`. Exact source byte/hash gates all pass; generated four-background per-asset PNGs, four contact sheets, 48/96/192/384 sheets and `.45/1/2` one-hex prop compositions. Font-cache warnings did not prevent output. Inspected all four contact backgrounds, full prop zoom composition and Crosswind idle/hit/defeated and working-cue scale sheets. No visible matte/checkerboard/clipping found. Alpha validator separately passes selected wind stabiliser, Crosswind idle and defeat. Seven painted props have zero detached pixels except socket's previously documented one pixel. Crosswind leaf/swirl islands are intentional: idle 952, telegraph 2163, hit 16933, defeat259 detached pixels; diagnostics preserved, no threshold changed or pixels removed. Hit/telegraph are staged, not requests to expand production state handling without actual events.

Props fit uniformly within one logical hex using existing `fitSpriteInHex`. Their full metadata ground anchor remains [192,330]; live prop fitting uses silhouette centre as existing contract, rather than treating the source ground point as tile hit geometry. Figures retain existing standing placement. At `.45` overview, fine fittings and badges need selected detail/live labels; native silhouettes are distinct. Badge geometry belongs in code; enlarged raster cue previews expose low resolution, so coding should prefer native SVG controls for scalable overlays when authorised.

Ravine mapping proposed: control -> existing ledger console; number/calibration -> power bus cabinet, keeping battlefield equation frame separate; shape/turning joint -> triangular brace; sustain -> two-sail wind stabiliser; alcove -> sheltered brace nook. Additional painted input over existing Four Locks selected station kit is only wind stabiliser 30,762 bytes. Preserve immutable provisional blueprint artIds and map family/entity in resolver. Control valid/corrupted, independent ready/held/damaged, and prepared/held alcove predicates stay production `stationPresentation` semantics. No independent alcove or control charge store.

Actual new legacy screenshots inspected read-only: Crosswind focused maximum, tablet native, phone native and desktop overview dated4October. Crosswind illustrated sprite is now visible in focused maximum and overview; original Cr placeholder gap is resolved by legacy import. The focus drawer covers much of its sprite, a coding/UI placement concern. Ravine stations remain generic glyphs. Opening native views put Crosswind offscreen and use Find cue: no evidence of missing art from those views. Furrow remains forward-facing with grounded feet. These are actual browser screenshot evidence produced by legacy worker, not screenshots produced by this isolated script or physical device tests.

Ready integration dependency: after explicit legacy release, claim renderer/station import manifest/test boundaries, add the wind stabiliser and family/entity mapping, then hand stable inputs to Claude for shared build. Coding owns MapViewport and drawer positioning. Current ownership check still shows TURNING-RAVINE and final-build active; no global edits or shared build attempted. Final station live min/native/max/state stacking, physical device and child acceptance remain unverified.
